commands.command:
set -eu
PKG=io.blueeye
adb start-server >/dev/null
AUTH=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{print $1}')
COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$AUTH" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
[ "$COUNT" = 1 ] || { adb devices -l; exit 31; }
SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$AUTH" | head -1)
adbx(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
echo SERIAL=$SERIAL
echo '=== CURRENT PROCESS ==='
adbx shell pidof $PKG || true
echo '=== CURRENT SERVICE DUMP ==='
adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG || true
echo '=== COMPONENT DUMP ==='
adbx shell dumpsys activity service $PKG/io.blueeye.service.ScannerService || true
echo '=== RECENT LIFECYCLE LOG ==='
adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService.*lifecycle=|ScannerService.*Bluetooth|BleScanner|FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in io.blueeye|SecurityException' | tail -600 || true
echo '=== TEMP REPORT FILES ==='
ls -la /tmp/tracker-phase2-device-acceptance 2>/dev/null || true
for f in /tmp/tracker-phase2-device-acceptance/log-bt* /tmp/tracker-phase2-device-acceptance/log-cycles.txt /tmp/tracker-phase2-device-acceptance/db-before.txt; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  echo "--- $f ---"
  tail -300 "$f" || true
done
echo BT_DIAG=PASS
